title: pr-lens workflow: model failure no longer fails the check
summary: The pr-lens GitHub Actions workflow is reworked so that a failed model call is no longer a hard gate. The analyze step now runs with `continue-on-error: true` and captures its output through `tee`, extracting the first `✗` line as a failure reason. A new step writes that reason into the PR's pr-lens section via the `osf` CLI, and the render/publish/write-section steps are re-gated on `steps.analyze.outcome == 'success'` instead of re-testing the docs-only and key-present conditions. The shell variable rename from `KEY_VAR`/`KEY` to `key_var`/`key` is cosmetic.

nodes.label: pr-lens.yml
nodes.subtitle: workflow job
nodes.summary: The workflow definition changed: the analyze step gained an id and continue-on-error, output is teed to a log, and downstream steps are gated on the analyze outcome.

nodes.label: Analyze the diff
nodes.subtitle: id: analyze, continue-on-error
nodes.summary: Runs the pr-lens CLI against the PR base and head SHAs. Now tolerates failure, tees stdout/stderr to analyze.log, and writes the first ✗ line to analyze-reason.txt before exiting with the CLI's status.

nodes.label: Write a note when the model call failed
nodes.subtitle: if: steps.analyze.outcome == 'failure'
nodes.summary: New step that reads analyze-reason.txt, formats a short note, and hands it to the osf CLI to post as the pr-lens section.

nodes.label: Render the diagrams
nodes.subtitle: if: steps.analyze.outcome == 'success'
nodes.summary: Renders the graph JSON to SVGs. Its condition changed from docs-only/key-present checks to the analyze step's outcome.

nodes.label: Publish the SVGs
nodes.subtitle: id: publish
nodes.summary: Pushes rendered assets to the pr-lens branch and emits the assets URL. Now gated on analyze success.

nodes.label: Write the diagram section
nodes.subtitle: osf pr section write
nodes.summary: Writes the rendered diagram section onto the pull request. Now gated on analyze success.
